messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: PROD streaming tail latency (service=tok-preproc) p99 > 1500ms, p95 > 700ms. Triggered 03:14 UTC. Affected routes: /v1/stream, /v1/chat/stream. Pager: sev2. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/d/latency/preproc?panelId=12 :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: Paging @Priya (primary oncall) and @Sam (secondary). Please ack and triage.

Priya: Acked. Looking at traces — majority of tails show long time in `prompt_expand` and `tokenizer_queue`. Streaming chunks delayed 6-20s before first token.

Alex: Noticing a deploy ~03:08 UTC for `prompt-templater:v3` rolled out to preproc by CI. It introduced new conditional helpers and `regex_replace_all` used in customer templates.

Sam: Can we see slow logs?

Mei: Pasting sampled logs: ```WARN preproc.prompt: template_compile slow template_id=tpl-77 duration_ms=420
WARN preproc.prompt: template_expand slow prompt_id=abc duration_ms=605
ERROR preproc.stream: chunk_timeout prompt_id=abc attempt=1 waited_ms=12000```

Priya: Hypothesis: the templater compiles heavy regex/conditionals per request in JSON-mode and isn't cached, blocking the hot path. That plus tokenizer queue backlog causes streaming stalls and SLO breach.

Alex: Confirmed—templater uses synchronous compilation for helpers when `PROMPT_ENGINE_JSON=true`. We missed adding a compilation cache in v3.

Priya: Impact assessment: ~8% of streaming sessions saw stall >10s in last 15m, several enterprise customers reported partial disconnections. Error rate for /v1/stream rose from 0.2% -> 3.1%.

Sam: Short-term mitigations to try (ranked):
1) toggle PROMPT_ENGINE_JSON=false cluster-wide (fast config flip)
2) rollback prompt-templater:v3 to v2 with `kubectl rollout undo deployment/prompt-templater -n prod`
3) apply edge streaming chunk token-bucket limiter and increase client-side keepalive
4) redirect high-volume customers to a safer preproc pool without templater change

Priya: I'm going to flip the JSON flag on a canary pod first. Command: `kubectl set env deployment/preproc PROMPT_ENGINE_JSON=false -n prod --overwrite`

oncall-bot: Applying env change to 1/8 pods (canary).

Priya: Canary pod p95 dropped from 750ms -> 190ms within 90s, p99 -> ~270ms.

Alex: Great. If canary is good, roll to full. Also prepare rollback just in case.

Priya: Rolling to full cluster now.

Sam: While that rolls, I'll push a temporary edge limiter: `edge.config.stream.chunk_rate=150/s` and `edge.config.stream.burst=300`. This will reduce sudden queue bursts.

Mei: Flag rolled to all preproc pods. Monitoring.

Priya: Post-rollout metrics: cluster p95 ~220ms, p99 ~310ms, streaming chunk timeouts back down to baseline.

Alex: Customer-success note: Nadia, I think we should notify affected customers with: what happened, mitigation applied, and next steps (perf fix & postmortem).

Nadia: I'll draft an external message: "We've applied an immediate mitigation (disabled JSON-mode for prompt templater) and performance is restored. Root cause investigation underway; full postmortem within 48 hours." Will send to CSMs + account owners.

Priya: Preliminary root cause: prompt-templater v3 introduced per-request regex compilation and conditional helper execution in JSON-mode. There was no per-template compile cache nor async compilation, so CPU and latency spiked for requests using complex templates. This created head-of-line blocking for streaming sessions.

Sam: Follow-ups and owners:
- Alex: implement compile-on-write cache and add async helper execution (owner: Alex)
- Mei: add e2e perf gate in CI for templater changes with a synthetic streaming workload (owner: Mei)
- Priya: add alert `preproc.template_compile_p99 > 100ms` and metric `preproc.template_compile_ms` (owner: Priya)
- Sam + Alex: coordinate safe rollout plan + canary policy (owner: Sam & Alex)
- Nadia: communicate to customers and consolidate impact notes (owner: Nadia)

Alex: I'll open a PR to introduce a templater cache keyed by template fingerprint and compile-time memoization. Also will add a flag `TEMPLATER_ASSUME_CACHED=true` for future rollouts.

Mei: For CI gating, I'll add a perf test that runs templater workload with JSON-mode on 1000 small prompts and asserts p99 < 200ms.

Priya: Handoff: I'm handing oncall to Sam in 30m. Current status: mitigated, metrics stable for 6 minutes, mitigation is config flag. Do not promote v3 templater until fixes + perf gate done.

Sam: Taking over. I'll keep watch and aim to close after 60m stable metrics. Starting incident timeline draft now.

incidents-bot: Incident recorded as Sev2. Mitigation applied. Postmortem required.

Priya: One more ask—please instrument `preproc.template_compile_count` and `preproc.template_compile_ms` with per-template labels so we can catch future regressions earlier.

Sam: Added to follow-ups. I'll open the postmortem ticket and assign Sam/Alex/Mei as owners.

Nadia: External update sent to CSMs. I'll ping here when customers ack.

Sam: Thanks team. :heart: Will schedule a postmortem sync for tomorrow 14:00 UTC.
